description: Whatever the client is meant to read gets saved with a name, a date and a reference to cite instead of being dropped into the chat; Files is where it lands
client_copy: Lo que te arma queda guardado con nombre y fecha en tus Archivos, siempre en el mismo lugar.
_comment: IT DEPENDS ON kanban because a deliverable is the OUTPUT of a ticket: the
reference the skill returns is what the ticket cites when it closes, and
the Files page reads it back next to the work that produced it.
